correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, translation reduces every member to support weight <=2; pairwise intersecting 2-supports are a star or triangle, forcing exactly three maximal templates. Explicit maximality proofs cover all three, and distinct templates meet in <=3 vertices, so every face of size >=4 has one maximal extension. Degree counting gives edge coefficient and rooted-triangle enumeration gives triangle coefficient; binomial subsets of unique maximal balls plus individual four-facets give all higher coefficients. The resulting total agrees with algebra. Independent stdlib brute subset census for n=3,4 and maximal-clique enumeration n=3..7 verify all displayed coefficients in that range. Finite checks are not used to infer n-uniform correctness.

value.rationale: The recent 2026 anticode counting paper leaves the fixed binary diameter-two count at 2^{Theta(n)}; this theorem supplies a complete natural face-vector and exact total, including sharp leading asymptotic 2*4^n. Its three structural maximal classes also determine all maximal faces of an actively studied simplicial complex VR(Q_n;2), a useful invariant not recoverable from its known homotopy type. The full natural infinite-family classification is mathematically motivated and not a miscellaneous finite table.
